style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-fruit premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft blush-pink background #F9CDD3, clean white #FFFFFF, deep plum-brown text #5C2530 and one berry-red accent #D7294A; warm tone; soft diffused top light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows only, dewy fresh mood, never harsh speculars, fruit never looks plastic; modern rounded sans-serif headlines in deep plum #5C2530 or white #FFFFFF, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded-corner cards and pill-shaped labels; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, the product always shown plump and glossy with natural seeded skin texture; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: strawberries always shown plump and glossy with natural seeded skin texture, stable generous scale, no reshaping between shots; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
